description: Tool schemas get re-prefilled on every LLM request. ContextCache compiles them into a KV cache once, stores it on disk and reuses it across users and sessions — TTFT stays near 200ms with 50 tools instead of 5.6s (Qwen3-8B, RTX 3090 Ti).
